name: Conversation & Agent Trace Viewer
blurb: a chat or agent transcript split into turns and tool calls, with tokens per turn and where the context grew
intro: Reads an Anthropic Messages, OpenAI chat or Claude Code session transcript and lays it out as turns with their tool calls, the context as it grew (measured from usage fields where the trace has them, else estimated at characters / 4) and what is wrong: calls without results, repeated identical calls, very large results and tool errors.

inputs.label: Transcript
inputs.help: Anthropic Messages JSON (array or request body), OpenAI chat JSON, or JSONL: one message per line, or a Claude Code session file (~/.claude/projects/<dir>/<session>.jsonl).

inputs.label: Large result from
inputs.help: A tool result or turn adding at least this many tokens is marked as a spike.

inputs.label: Loop after identical calls
inputs.help: The same tool with the same input this many times is reported as a possible loop.

inputs.label: Price input
inputs.help: Only used when the trace has no cost fields. Take prices from the provider's pricing page; they change.

examples.title: Claude Code session: a failing unit test, a big Read, an Edit error, the same test run three times, a cut-off TodoWrite
OpenAI chat with tool_calls, no usage (estimated tokens), a rate-limit error and a repeated call

usage: Give trace as the transcript text (Anthropic Messages JSON or JSONL, OpenAI chat JSON, or a Claude Code session .jsonl), optionally format, bigResult (tokens) and loopRepeat; priceIn/priceOut (USD per million tokens) only if the trace has no cost fields. Returns turn and tool-call counts, peak and final context (measured from usage, else estimated), cache-read share, cost if known, tool calls by name, the largest results, the context spikes, and warnings for tool calls without results, repeated identical calls, large results and tool errors. Use it to see why an agent run got slow, expensive or stuck.
sources: Anthropic Messages API reference: content blocks text, tool_use, tool_result (is_error), thinking; usage input_tokens, cache_creation_input_tokens, cache_read_input_tokens, output_tokens
Anthropic docs, extended thinking: previous turns' thinking blocks are not counted in the context window
OpenAI Chat Completions API reference: tool_calls, role tool with tool_call_id, usage prompt_tokens / completion_tokens / prompt_tokens_details.cached_tokens
Claude Code session files as written by Claude Code 2.x (one JSON event per line; observed format, not a published spec)
